query:
SELECT soi.status as itemStatus, soi.productionDestination, COUNT(*) as cnt, so.status as orderStatus
FROM salonOrderItems soi 
JOIN salonOrders so ON soi.orderId = so.id 
WHERE so.companyId = 2 
AND soi.createdAt >= '2026-03-01' 
AND soi.createdAt <= '2026-03-09'
GROUP BY soi.status, soi.productionDestination, so.status
ORDER BY so.status, soi.status
